content1: The Video Record Timer Configuration schedules video recording times with customizable duration, circular recording, event recording, pre-recording and post-recording intervals.
content2: The structures RecordingConfig defines the configuration settings for video recording, including recording duration, circular recording enablement, event recording enablement, pre-event duration, and post-event duration.
getAPIDes: This function will get the Video record Timer Configuration Information from the SHELFVista camera.
setAPIDes: This function will set the Video record Timer Configuration Information to the SHELFVista camera.
